description: Send an invitation to a new member to join the organization. The invitee receives an email with a link to accept.

canViewConversations.description: Whether the invited member can view conversations (default: true)

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

name.description: Full name of the person being invited

role.description: Role to assign to the member (e.g., 'admin', 'agent', 'viewer')

name: neuron_invite_member
